eyebrow: The workflow, triggered on every pull request
code:
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  dbt-build-and-test:
    env:
      DBT_CI_SCHEMA: PR_${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
    steps:
      - run: dbt deps
      - run: dbt build --target ci --fail-fast
      - run: dbt test --target ci
caption: Each PR gets its own disposable Snowflake schema -- never dev, never prod.
